purpose: Teach: 夢想/貪欲/空虚/アクシデント/を通じまして/うねり/交わり/地平線

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の夢想と現実認識のずれを医療チームで丁寧に評価します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team carefully evaluates the gap between our patients' hopes and their understanding of reality.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady professional tone. Slight pause after the name, signaling this is a formal statement of institutional value. No condescension.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、貪欲なまでに研究を続ける医師団を医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren, we support our physicians in pursuing research with genuine commitment and rigor.
lines.style: Even delivery, emphasizing the weight of 'support.' Calm but not distant. A statement of institutional philosophy, not mere policy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、終末期患者様の空虚感に寄り添う事を医療チームで大事にします
lines.en: Ren, we prioritize walking alongside end-of-life patients through their sense of emptiness.
lines.style: Slower pace on this one. Soft gravity in the voice—this is tender work. Not performative, but genuinely present. Slight breath before the core idea.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、手術中のアクシデント時の対応を医療チームで訓練します
lines.en: Ren, we train our medical team to respond well when accidents happen during surgery.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact without being cold. Professional acknowledgment of real danger. Confidence underlying the words—this is why we prepare.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 臨床ご経験を通じまして得た知見を、貴院、若手にお伝えですね、先生
lines.en: So you're passing along what you've learned through your clinical experience to the younger doctors here at the hospital, then, Sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal register. Respectful half-question—Ren is checking his understanding while affirming what he's heard. Genuine curiosity underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染拡大のうねりに合わせ、医療チームで体制を組みます
lines.en: Ren, as the waves of infection spread, we adapt our medical team's structure to meet the moment.
lines.style: Steady tempo, no rush. Acknowledgment of scale and challenge without alarm. Professional calm that comes from experience facing crises before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近隣病院との交わりを医療チームで深めます
lines.en: Ren, we deepen our connections with the neighboring hospitals through our medical team's collaboration.
lines.style: Even pacing, clear-eyed. Connection is work—the style should reflect intention and commitment, not passive sentiment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地平線まで届く僻地医療の活動を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Ren, we continue the work of rural medicine that reaches all the way to the horizon.
lines.style: Slight pause before the final phrase. Quieter, more reflective. The horizon image carries weight—this is a vision statement, not a logistical update. Soft close.
